_doc: Todd, reclassified — the same man, now a salaried Shop Manager over the oil and tire bays. Uses the engine's companion slot (joinWhenFlag) to represent the same person 'reclassing' into a new role with a new skill kit, since the campaign has no true companions.
name: Todd
title: Shop Manager
samplePhrase: Six bays and a line of pickups — let's move some oil.
